about: A virus scanner or Windows SmartScreen flags or blocks a VertexForge file

Thank you! Every report is passed on to the scanner vendor as a possible false positive and listed openly on the website.

**Which file?** (e.g. VertexForge-Studio-Setup.exe, version 2.3.0)

**SHA-256 of your file** (Windows: `certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256`) – does it match the website?

**Which scanner, and what exactly does it say?** (product name + detection name, screenshot welcome)

**VirusTotal link** (optional)
